estimation_note: Engineer-weeks are rough scope estimates for experienced maintainers, not commitments or benchmark findings. Tasks overlap in design/testing; do not add ranges mechanically. Phase effort bands in the report are the budgeting guide.

priority_definition.P0-before-autonomy: Required before allowing unattended model-selected execution beyond the current trusted-operator threat model.
priority_definition.P1: Reliability, correctness, observability or release foundation.
priority_definition.P2: Scale, efficiency or optional capability expansion.

tickets.title: Correct timestamps and build-attributed tracing
implementation: Capture UTC and steady request start at the same post-idle read boundary; retain separate connection and receive-start timestamps.
Record deployment generation, binary digest, run/operation IDs, phase timings and typed outcome categories.
acceptance_criteria: An injected 10-second keep-alive idle does not appear in subsequent handling duration.
Wall/steady deltas agree within declared resolution absent clock adjustment.
Application nonzero exits and intentional waits do not count as infrastructure latency/failure.

tickets.title: One canonical capability and contract manifest
implementation: Generate tool schemas, permission metadata, aliases, docs and declared counts from one registry.
Preserve frozen legacy request/response behavior; correct implementation-specific descriptions separately.
acceptance_criteria: All 50 current names accounted for; stale count 47 eliminated.
All platform profiles and legacy/modern protocol compatibility gates pass.

tickets.title: Matched benchmark and failure taxonomy
implementation: Benchmark localhost and tunneled paths separately with fixed payloads, commands, datasets and cache states.
Record admissions, processing, child work, encoding, transfer, timer lateness and observer cost separately.
acceptance_criteria: At least 1000 observations per short-operation class and multiple runs; publish p50/p95/p99 with uncertainty.
Build/binary/toolchain/CPU/power profile pinned; no production stress traffic.

tickets.title: Capability grants and low-privilege execution profile
implementation: Make trusted elevated operator mode explicit; default autonomous workers to least privilege.
Authorize exact operation, principal, workspace, executable identity, argument constraints, egress and expiry.
Keep administration/update credentials and desktop input in separate narrowly authorized brokers.
acceptance_criteria: Revoked/expired grants reject before side effects.
Readonly shell hints never represented as OS-enforced sandboxing.
Symlink/reparse, argument interpreter and executable substitution adversarial tests pass.

tickets.title: Secret-safe telemetry and environment isolation
implementation: Schema-level deny-by-default recording of arguments, stdin, file content and task state.
Construct child environment from an allowlist; inject scoped secret references only through broker-controlled channels.
Separate durable security audit events from lossy operational telemetry; enforce byte and count budgets.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic canary credentials do not appear in process environment, argv, logs, export or crash bundle unless explicitly authorized.
Audit spool failure produces explicit policy behavior, never silent evidence loss.

tickets.title: Response and worker resource containment
implementation: Add per-write idle deadlines, overall response budgets and aggregate queued/in-flight byte limits.
Keep health and cancel control traffic reserved under large JSON and slow-reader load.
Separate potentially uninterruptible operations into killable worker processes with explicit shutdown escalation.
Extend existing per-execution Job Objects with compatible limits and test kill-on-owner-close without killing durable runners on frontend restart.
acceptance_criteria: Slow readers and high fanout remain within configured byte/connection budgets.
Shutdown reaches its declared deadline during stuck-worker injection.
Foreground orphan tests and durable-runner survival tests both pass.

tickets.title: Dependency and binary release assurance
implementation: Promote exact tested artifacts; attach signed provenance, SBOM, dependency notices and vulnerability results.
Add Windows ASan/analysis and separate Linux TSan/fuzz lanes where supported.
Gate CI cache reuse by exact compiler, SDK, triplet, flags and dependency baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Downloaded artifact digest, test receipt digest and deployed digest identical.
Failure to verify signature, schema compatibility or required tests prevents promotion.
All bundled dependency notices enumerated from the resolved graph.

tickets.title: Indexed durable state and fenced coordinator
implementation: Introduce a StateStore interface and local single-writer SQLite/WAL metadata store or equivalent transactional implementation.
Index runs, jobs, operations, events and resource leases; retain artifact files out of the database.
Migrate with one authoritative writer and generation fencing; retain export/recovery compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: 10k/100k-record list and receipt admission tests have bounded work/page.
Crash between every durable transition preserves operation identity and truthful uncertain state.
Rollback cannot resurrect already admitted external effects.

tickets.title: Event-driven scheduler and completion waits
implementation: Notify same-process waiters and cross-process workers through authenticated IPC; preserve periodic reconciliation.
Replace 10ms future polling with completion/deadline/cancellation arbitration.
Keep weighted fairness and interactive reservation; add memory/GPU/disk resource dimensions.
acceptance_criteria: When capacity is free, notification-to-grant p95 below 20ms in the qualification workload.
No starvation, double lease or stale-owner release under restart and PID reuse tests.
Successful 1-2ms admission fast path does not regress materially.

tickets.title: Content-addressed resumable artifact uploads
implementation: Separate upload staging from final atomic publish; hash each chunk and verify whole-file hash once at finalize.
Use idempotent upload IDs/chunk offsets; maintain final file CAS protection.
Bound large-directory enumeration independently from displayed result count.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated chunk writes are replay-safe; interrupted finalization leaves either old or new published artifact.
Uploaded-byte I/O scales linearly rather than recopying the previous prefix per chunk.
Very large directories remain within a stated memory ceiling.

tickets.title: Measured allocation and observer optimization
implementation: A/B test global allocation instrumentation versus sampled or thread-local counters.
Use typed snapshots and reusable buffers; avoid repeated copying/sorting of timer-lateness windows.
Try PGO only with representative workloads and independently validated profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate service CPU improvement under matched workload without hidden telemetry loss.
No precision change silently relabels a metric; no safety or cross-platform regressions.

tickets.title: Model-provider and local-worker adapters
implementation: Implement explicit generate/stream/cancel/usage interfaces with provider-specific capability negotiation.
Use direct APIs or isolated local inference servers; do not build new orchestration on deprecated MCP sampling.
Enforce model/context/VRAM/token/cost budgets and robust partial tool-call parsing.
acceptance_criteria: Test adapter reconnect, malformed streaming fragments, cancellation, rate limits and unknown billing/response outcomes.
Keys never enter generic worker environment or model-visible context.
Unsupported model tool/vision capabilities fail explicitly.

tickets.title: Durable run controller and approval state machine
implementation: Persist model rounds, tool calls, grants, checkpoints, context manifests and observed effects.
Implement run create/get/events/pause/resume/cancel/approve; bound turns, repetitions, cost and output.
Use existing operation-ID deduplication underneath an outbox and effect-state reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: Restart at every run transition recovers without duplicated admitted effects.
Unknown external outcomes pause for reconciliation rather than blind retry.
Cancellation receipt and actual terminal state are distinct and auditable.

tickets.title: Harness evaluation and adversarial regression suite
implementation: Pair task-success, cost, calls, completion time and edit correctness against a frozen baseline.
Exercise prompt injection, untrusted evidence, approvals, context compaction and cross-run information isolation.
Add deterministic controller fixtures and recorded provider traces; distinguish replay from deterministic model generation.
acceptance_criteria: No increase in unauthorized side effects or secret exposure in the adversarial corpus.
Report success-rate confidence intervals and per-task outcomes, not only aggregate token throughput.
Automatic budget/loop circuit breakers verified.

tickets.title: MCP Tasks, resources and optional UI integration
implementation: Map durable jobs/runs to the current opt-in Tasks extension.
Expose artifact/evidence resources and versioned workflow instructions; optionally add approval/run-monitor UI.
Keep existing job tools as fallback and constrain caching to authorization-equivalent views.
acceptance_criteria: Never return task-shaped results to clients that did not negotiate support.
Reconnect/cancel/input-required flows pass current and legacy client matrix tests.

tickets.title: Research quality and provider extensibility
implementation: Preserve actual checked_at, source content hashes, stock, SKU/variant and payment distinctions.
Add provider adapters with explicit terms and coverage; support HTTP-date Retry-After and consistent egress policy.
Evaluate domain diversity, primary evidence coverage and incomplete queries rather than rewarding source count alone.
acceptance_criteria: Inaccessible/currently failed sources never reuse stale prices as current.
Existing peer-IP/private-address/redirect/TLS/budget tests continue passing.

tickets.title: Platform-specific execution and desktop expansion
implementation: Add a structured WSL backend with explicit distribution/path mapping rather than treating arbitrary host shell as a portable API.
Qualify native Linux/macOS/Android capabilities independently; add real-device arm64/mobile lifecycle tests before claims.
Preserve single-owner desktop input and fresh observation semantics; use platform-granted desktop permissions.
acceptance_criteria: Platform manifest distinguishes unavailable, unsupported and permission-denied capabilities.
Existing Windows popup/coordinate/stale-observation protections remain covered.

tickets.title: Canary, migration and rollback certification
implementation: Run isolated canaries, one-writer state migration, staged admission drain and exact-artifact promotion.
Preserve Guardian/tunnel ownership; separate worker/frontend lifetimes and state format versions.
Conduct rollback and recovery drills with durable runner and operation receipts intact.
acceptance_criteria: No lost acknowledged job or duplicate effect in deployment/restart tests.
Healthy known-good C++ release can be restored without unsafe state downgrade.
All release health, isolation, budget, performance and compatibility gates pass.
